CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Product2Id), TEXT(Product2.Family) <> "Scanner" ), "N/A", IF( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Assigned"), "Signed (Not Shipped)", IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Shipped"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Deployed") ), IF( ISBLANK(Deployment_Date__c), "Onboarding (Missing Date)", IF( TODAY() - Deployment_Date__c < 84, "Onboarding (1-12 Weeks)", "Mature (12 Weeks+)" ) ), "N/A" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines maturity of asset if the product family = scanner
CustomField.label: Scanner Maturity
